changeSet.sql: update F set F.LookupObjectType = null, F.LookupObjectId = null from FieldType F where (F.LookupObjectType is not null or F.LookupObjectID is not null) and F.[Type] not in ( 'Lookup' ,'Relationship' ,'Fieldfromrelationship' ,'Reflistrelationship' ,'Fusionlookup' ,'Filteredlookup' ,'Ownershiplookup' )
